description:
Prepare a human enquiry for a selected car; use compare_vehicles before choosing and prepare_part_handoff for spare parts.

- vehicle_id fixes the advert to enquire about. A slug resolves to canonical listing_id so the link and refreshed asking-price summary refer to the same advert; neither identifies an auction event.
- note adds the buyer's question to that enquiry, not an instruction to change price or certify condition. It is embedded in the link; omit unnecessary personal details.
- This anonymous lookup prepares links only. The human reviews and decides whether to send; JOY confirms availability, inspection and terms. No enquiry, booking, reservation, bid, order or payment is made.

note.description: Optional human enquiry, e.g. request an inspection or confirm availability. Included in the pre-filled link; not submitted by this tool.

vehicle_id.description: A selected listing_id from search_vehicles/compare_vehicles, or a public listing slug. Supply only the ID/slug, not a full URL or VIN.

name: prepare_vehicle_handoff
title: Prepare a human car enquiry
